description: Extend rename/move detection to match fields that were renamed AND changed simultaneously, using Levenshtein path similarity and value similarity scoring

specs.description: Exact rename (same value, different leaf name) continues to work — backward compatibility
specs.given: Field 'billing' with value 'auto' in old spec; field 'collection_method' with value 'auto' in new spec
specs.then: Returns a single DiffResult of type 'renamed' with path='billing', newPath='collection_method', confidence >= 0.9

domain_conventions.threshold: Exact value match sets valueSimilarity=1.0, boosting combined score above threshold
domain_conventions.backward_compat: Exact-match path (serialize equality index) must still be tried first before fuzzy

specs.description: Rename with value change is detected when combined score >= 0.65
specs.given: Field 'account_balance' with value 0 in old spec; field 'balance' with value 0.00 in new spec (same numeric quantity, different representation)
specs.then: Returns a single DiffResult of type 'renamed' (not removed+added), with confidence in [0.65, 1.0)

specs.given: Field 'user.name' with value 'Alice' in old spec; field 'user.displayName' with value 'alice' in new spec
specs.then: Returns DiffResult of type 'renamed' with confidence in [0.65, 1.0)

specs.description: Best-match wins when multiple candidates exist above threshold
specs.given: Old spec has field 'price'; new spec has two candidates: 'pricing' (pathSim=0.83) and 'cost' (pathSim=0.40), both with identical values
specs.then: Returns DiffResult of type 'renamed' with newPath='pricing' (highest score), not 'cost'

domain_conventions.algorithm: Iterate all fb-only candidates, track best score; select winner only after full scan — not first-match

specs.description: Fields with completely different names AND different values are NOT matched as renames
specs.given: Old spec has field 'billing' with value 'auto'; new spec has field 'collection_method' with value 'manual' — path similarity 0.12, value similarity 0.0
specs.then: Returns two separate DiffResults: type='removed' for 'billing' and type='added' for 'collection_method' — combined score 0.072 is below 0.65 threshold

domain_conventions.threshold: Below-threshold candidates must fall through to removed+added, not produce low-confidence rename entries

specs.description: levenshtein(a, b) returns 0 for identical strings and max(len(a),len(b)) for completely disjoint strings
specs.given: Pure function inputs: levenshtein('rename','rename') and levenshtein('abc','xyz')

domain_conventions.algorithm: Standard Wagner-Fischer dynamic programming; O(n*m) time, O(min(n,m)) space

specs.description: pathSimilarity returns 1.0 for empty strings (both empty = identical)

domain_conventions.guard: maxLen === 0 guard must return 1.0 before division

specs.description: valueSimilarity returns 0.0 for different types (no cross-type fuzzy matching)
specs.then: Returns 0.0 (different types short-circuit to no similarity)

domain_conventions.reason: Cross-type fuzzy matching would produce unreliable scores; type-mismatch means structurally different fields

specs.description: matchScore weights path similarity 60% and value similarity 40%
specs.given: matchScore called with pathSimilarity=0.8 and valueSimilarity=0.5
specs.when: matchScore(oldPath, newPath, oldVal, newVal) is called

domain_conventions.weights: Path similarity weighted higher because field name is the primary identity; value change alone should not drive a rename match

specs.description: Fuzzy rename detection integrates with existing confidence field on DiffResult
specs.given: A rename detected via fuzzy matching with matchScore=0.72
specs.then: DiffResult.confidence = 0.72 (rounded to 2dp); type = 'renamed'; existing exact-match renames retain confidence >= 0.9

domain_conventions.field: confidence field already defined in DiffResult interface — no type changes needed
